_comment: Expected SEL drawing PDFs, committed alongside their metadata so the repo
is self-contained. They are SEL copyrighted works: keep this repository
private and do not redistribute them from here. sha256 pins the exact
revision the crop rectangles and layer rules in each metadata.json were
authored against - a newer revision of the same drawing number will render
misaligned, so mismatches are reported rather than silently accepted. To
refresh or add drawings, use scripts/fetch-sel-drawings.mjs with your own
